about.hero_subtitle: Built by gamers. For gamers who want more.
about.mission_body: PeakGG exists because competitive gaming deserves a better home. Fair matchmaking, real tournaments, a community that pushes you to your peak. We built what we wanted to play on.
about.story_body: Started in 2026 in Brussels, Belgium. PeakGG was born from frustration with existing platforms — laggy, unfair, soulless. Two people, one vision: build the platform serious FPS players actually deserve.
about.value_fair_desc: Every match is fair. Anti-smurf, ELO-based, no pay-to-win.
about.value_competition_desc: From Open Cup to Peak Championship. Real stakes, real growth.
about.value_community_desc: Discord, chat, LFT board. Your squad is here.
about.value_safety_desc: GDPR compliant. Your data is yours. Always.

faq.subtitle: Search or browse by category.
faq.q_what_is_a: PeakGG is a free competitive gaming platform for Valorant, CS2 and Rainbow Six Siege. Ranked matchmaking, tournaments, team management and community — all in one place.
faq.q_free_a: Yes, completely free. Register at peakgg.net and start competing immediately. No subscription required.
faq.q_games_a: Valorant is live now. CS2 and Rainbow Six Siege are coming soon — leave your email on those pages to be notified first.
faq.q_register_q: How do I create an account?
faq.q_register_a: Click "Start Playing" on the homepage, fill in your username and email, and you're in. Takes 30 seconds.
faq.q_rank_works_q: How does the rank system work?
faq.q_rank_works_a: PeakGG uses an ELO-based system. Win matches to gain ELO, lose matches to lose ELO. Your rank updates automatically after every match.
faq.q_smurf_a: PeakGG detects accounts that perform significantly above their rank and adjusts their ELO faster to place them correctly.
faq.q_elo_amount_q: How much ELO do I gain or lose?
faq.q_elo_amount_a: Win: +25 ELO. Loss: −20 ELO. Minimum ELO is 0.
faq.q_join_tournament_q: How do I join a tournament?
faq.q_join_tournament_a: Go to /tournaments, find an open tournament and click Register. Make sure you meet the rank requirement if any.
faq.q_tournament_free_a: Open Cup tournaments are completely free. Future premium tiers may have entry fees paid with PeakCoins.
faq.q_tournament_tiers_a: Open Cup (free, anyone) → Challenger Series (Contender rank required) → Peak Championship (Elite rank required, invite only).
faq.q_prizes_a: Currently top 3 players receive exclusive rank badges and recognition. Prize pools with real value are coming in future seasons.
faq.q_create_team_q: How do I create a team?
faq.q_create_team_a: Go to /teams and click "Create Team". Choose a name, tag (3 letters) and game.
faq.q_invite_players_a: From your team page, click "Invite Player" and search by username.
faq.q_team_elo_a: Separate from your personal ELO — it reflects your team's performance in team tournaments.
faq.q_regions_a: Currently Europe. More regions coming soon.
faq.q_mobile_a: Not yet. The website is fully mobile responsive. A dedicated app is on the roadmap.
faq.q_bug_q: How do I report a bug?
faq.q_bug_a: Use the form at /contact or post in #bug-report on our Discord.
faq.q_delete_acc_q: How do I delete my account?
faq.q_delete_acc_a: Go to Settings → Account → Delete Account. Your data will be permanently deleted within 30 days.
faq.q_report_player_q: How do I report a player?
faq.q_report_player_a: Click the flag icon on any player's profile or match result.
faq.q_banned_q: What happens if I get banned?
faq.q_banned_a: You will receive an email explaining the reason. You can appeal at /contact with subject "Ban Appeal".
faq.q_gdpr_a: Yes. PeakGG is based in Belgium and fully compliant with EU GDPR regulations.
faq.q_data_a: Email, username, game stats, IP address for security, and usage data. Full details at /privacy.
faq.q_data_request_q: How do I request my data?
faq.q_data_request_a: Email peakgg.official@gmail.com with subject "Data Request". We respond within 48 hours.
faq.q_data_delete_q: How do I request data deletion?
faq.q_data_delete_a: Email peakgg.official@gmail.com with subject "Data Deletion". Completed within 30 days.
